data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD1: integration test merges story A into the session branch, queries DefenseStore.load_for_region, asserts attestations are returned (not stale-invalidated)
- DD2: legacy attestations without SHA-range fields fall back to diff_hash equality lookup with a logged warning
- DD3: Unit tests written and passing

## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh:

defense_store_write: when input JSON contains story_branch_tip_sha or story_branch_base_sha, carry them through to the persisted DEFENSE_RECORD comment verbatim. No injection when absent (legacy write path).

defense_store_load_for_region: after filtering by region_files path intersection (existing logic), apply SHA-range validation per record:
1. If record has both story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha: run git log --ancestry-path <base>..<tip> and check if DSO_QUERY_SHA (or HEAD) is in the output. Exclude if not in ancestry. Include if in ancestry.
2. If record lacks sha fields (legacy): log warning to stderr containing 'legacy attestation' and fall back to diff_hash equality.
Fail-open: if git log fails, include the record and log a warning.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh: modify
- tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh: now GREEN
- tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh: now GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/review/test-defense-store-sha-range.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] Legacy migration tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/review/test-defense-store-legacy-migration.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] SHA-range validation uses git ancestry-path
  Verify: grep -q 'ancestry-path' plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh
- [ ] Legacy fallback warns and uses diff_hash equality
  Verify: grep -q 'legacy attestation' plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Extend defense_store_write and defense_store_load_for_region with SHA-range protocol
